label: CoplexStdPy (LLM Task Harness)
description: Provider-neutral, Codex/Copilot-style repository task runtime with scoped tools, durable events, approvals, cancellation, and iterative read-only subagents.
summary: Configure the coding-task runtime, inspect its capability registry, and run explicitly enabled repository tasks through an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.

servicesEndpoint.description: Workbench enumerator of the harness router's registered routes (identical routes are mirrored by the standalone process on port 8850).

files.description: Workbench plugin entrypoint: adds src/ to sys.path and delegates to coplex_stdpy.server.
Public Python API exported from the installable coplex_stdpy package.
Provider-neutral task loop, guarded tools, adapters, and durable task manager.
FastAPI HTTP/admin routes consumed by plugin.py and coplex_stdpy.standalone.
Security boundary, API contract, and usage guide.
Same-origin task console for tasks, events, approvals, input, and cancellation.

steps: Install the package in editable mode: pip install -e ".[server,test]".
Confirm the configured OpenAI-compatible model endpoint is reachable.
Review the permission and approval defaults before enabling task execution.
Use an OS sandbox when model output is not fully trusted.
Disable task execution (executionEnabled: false) and stop any in-flight tasks before removing.
Remove the canonical workbench/plugins/coplex_stdpy directory and reinstall the repository package; durable runtime/coplex_stdpy task records are intentionally separate.

plugin-init.description: Redirects /coplex_stdpy to the standalone harness server (same routes as the embedded router, on its own port).

plugin-lifecycle.note: Dual-mode: the embedded router always registers on the workbench, and by default (COPLEX_STDPY_PLUGIN_MODE=standalone) create_router also launches a detached standalone process serving the same routes on port 8850 (COPLEX_STDPY_HTTP_PORT) behind the /coplex_stdpy web_proxy mount, so the harness survives workbench restarts. Set COPLEX_STDPY_PLUGIN_MODE=embedded for in-process only.

restart.description: Gracefully restart the standalone harness process: spawns a fresh detached process on the same host:port, then stops this one. Answers 501 on a process that has no registered restart hook (only coplex_stdpy.standalone registers one).

shutdown.description: Gracefully stop the standalone harness process (closes the task manager, then exits). Answers 501 on a process that has no registered shutdown hook (only coplex_stdpy.standalone registers one).

plugin-api.note: The embedded router mounted directly on the workbench API process has no shutdown/restart hook registered, by design: a request to this plugin's routes must never be able to take down the whole host process, so /admin/shutdown and /admin/restart answer 501 there. The standalone mirror on port 8850 (coplex_stdpy.standalone) registers real hooks against its own uvicorn.Server, so those two routes work there. /coplex_stdpy/tasks/{task_id}/cancel stops one running task, not the plugin itself.
